April 3 1926

REPORT ON Resignation of Baron Von Zadoff from Orenburg
Cossack Union.

Made by Tem. Cons. Cook Forwarded by W. Givens C. S. I.

Sir,

Enquiries show that Baron von Zadoff resigned
the presidency of the Orenburg Cossack Union in consequence
of the expulsion from that body of six members who, contrary to
orders, attended the Ball organized by the Shendrikoff Cossacks,
a rival organization. Baron von Zadoff considers that the
drastic action taken against these men for a trivial offence
proves the existence of spirit of intolerance among the members of
the committee which will eventually lead to dissension.
As he does not wish to have his name associated with such
trouble, he felt that he had better sever his connection with
the Union and submitted his resignation.

The Orenburg Cossacks are now seeking a new
President, and a further report will be submitted when they
have found one. .

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
John R. Cook.
Tem. Cons.

D. C. I.
（批：Sully） （批：Cmb / 5/4）

情报科驻所。
1926年4月3日

关于扎多夫男爵（Baron Von Zadoff）辞去奥伦堡哥萨克联合会主席职务的报告。

由临时警员库克（Tem. Cons. Cook）撰写，经西维恩斯（W. Givens），刑事调查主任（C. S. I.）转呈。

先生：

经查，扎多夫男爵辞去奥伦堡哥萨克联合会主席职务，原因是该组织开除了六名成员。这六名成员违反命令，参加了由敌对组织申德里科夫（Shendrikoff）哥萨克举办的舞会。扎多夫男爵认为，针对这些人的轻微过错采取如此严厉的行动，证明了委员会成员中存在不容异己的风气，这将最终导致分裂。由于他不希望自己的名字与此类纠纷联系在一起，他觉得最好切断与该联合会的联系，遂提交辞呈。

奥伦堡哥萨克人目前正在寻找新主席，待选出后，将提交进一步报告。

此致，
敬礼

您顺从的仆人，
约翰·R·库克（John R. Cook）
临时警员

副刑事调查主任（D. C. I.）
（批注：Sully） （批注：Cmb / 4月5日）

March 23 1926

REPORT ON Orenburg Cossack Union.

Made by Tem. Cons. Cook Forwarded by J. Givens C. D. I.

Sir,

Enquiries go to show that the New Orenburg Cossack Club, of which Baron Von Zadoff is President, is situated at No. 315 Rue Bourgeat, and its membership consists of forty three Cossacks. These, with few exceptions, are employed in positions which in the majority of cases were secured for them by Mr. Dolgorukoff of the Horse Bazaar. The latter, who is patron of the organization, has for several years promoted charitable enterprises for the benefit of Cossacks.

Enquiries indicate that the members of the Orenburg Cossack Club were formerly connected with the Cossack groups headed by Borodine and Shendrikoff, but broke away because they objected to alleged viciousness in the habits of other members of these organizations. Drunkenness, quarrelling and political discussions are prohibited in the new club which claims to have been formed to provide Cossacks with a place where they can meet to discuss matters of common interest, and where men temporarily unemployed can be accommodated. The membership is strictly confined to Cossacks of "White" opinions and special precautions are taken to prevent "reds" from obtaining admission. Avoidance of interference in political matters is, nevertheless, part of the policy of the club. The organization is maintained by a fee of 50 cents per month collected from the members and subsidies provided by Mr. Dolgorukoff, Mr. Morris and Mr. Olsen.

The Orenburg Cossack Club seems to be a deserving institution, but as it is located in French Concession, there

1926年3月23日

关于奥伦堡哥萨克联合会的报告。

由临时警员库克（Tem. Cons. Cook）撰写，经吉文斯（J. Givens），刑事调查主任（C. D. I.）转呈。

先生：

调查显示，由扎多夫男爵担任主席的新奥伦堡哥萨克俱乐部位于布尔热瓦路（Rue Bourgeat）315号，其成员由四十三名哥萨克人组成。除少数例外，这些人大多受雇于马匹集市（Horse Bazaar）的多尔戈鲁科夫先生（Mr. Dolgorukoff）为其安排的职位。后者作为该组织的赞助人，多年来一直推动有利于哥萨克人的慈善事业。

调查表明，奥伦堡哥萨克俱乐部的成员以前曾隶属于博罗丁（Borodine）和申德里科夫（Shendrikoff）领导的哥萨克团体，但因反对这些组织中其他成员据称存在的恶习而脱离。新俱乐部禁止酗酒、争吵和政治讨论，声称其成立目的是为哥萨克人提供一个聚会场所，以讨论共同感兴趣的事项，并为暂时失业者提供食宿。会员资格严格限于持有“白俄”观点的哥萨克人，并采取特别预防措施防止“赤色分子”加入。尽管如此，不干涉政治事务也是该俱乐部政策的一部分。该组织依靠向成员每月收取50分钱的会费以及多尔戈鲁科夫先生、莫里斯先生（Mr. Morris）和奥尔森先生（Mr. Olsen）提供的补贴来维持。

Sir:-

Referring to our conversation of the 4th ult., regarding
the registration of our Union, and in fulfilment of my promise then
made to you, I herewith beg respectfully to submit the Rules of our
Organization as well as a list giving the names of its members.

However, it is understood that the rules and list of names
are for your personal reference only, and I, therefore, would request

page_data.en:
RULES
of the
ORENBOURG COSSACK UNION.
Shanghai.

Translated from Russian.
-------------------------
6987
25/3/26

1. The Union is being created with the object of mutual material and moral support among Orenbourg Cossacks. - It does not pursue political ends.

2. With a view of attaining such object, the Union will get into touch with Russian (Non-Bolsheviks) and Foreign enterprises as well as with individuals trying every possible way to provide employment for its Members. It will watch those Members already employed that they carry out their duties carefully and satisfactorily.

3. The Union, as a body, has its home, which serves as a place of recreation and meeting to its Members, and to those Members as may be without work and means - as a shelter.

4. Eligible to Membership of the Union are besides Orenbourg Cossacks all Russian Emigrants and Foreigners who have rendered a substantial service to the Union. - Women cannot become Members of the Union.

5. Bolsheviks cannot become Members of the Union, neither can any person sympathizing the "Reds."

6. Every Member pays a monthly fee of not less than M$ 0.50 to the funds of the Union against a receipt of the Treasurer. Foreigners pay not less than M$ 50.00 per mensem. The first Membership fee is due as from January 1st, 1926.

7. Those who have no means nor employment are exempt from payment of the Membership fee.

8. Those who desire to become Members of the Union after its opening and who were not inclined to do so theretofore pay an entrance fee of M$ 5.00.

9. Only such Members as are Orenbourg Cossacks are eligible to the Management of the Union.

10. The Management of the Union consists of:

(a) The President, whose duty is the general direction of the Union's affairs and the superintendence of its funds;

(b) The Treasurer, who is also Secretary, is in charge of receipt, safekeeping and disbursement of monies (the latter only by order of the President) and maintains the accounts and conducts correspondence etc.;

(c) Two Syndics of the Union, who are part of the Management for solving any kind of questions.

11. The Management can be summoned by the President, or in cases of emergency, by a notification of one of the Members of the Management.
page_data.zh:
奥伦堡哥萨克联合会
章程
上海。

译自俄文。
-------------------------
6987
1926年3月25日

1. 本联合会的创立旨在奥伦堡哥萨克人之间提供物质和精神上的相互支持。——本会不追求政治目的。

2. 为实现此目标，本会将与俄罗斯（非布尔什维克）及外国企业以及个人建立联系，尽一切可能为其成员提供就业机会。本会将监督已就业的成员，确保他们认真且令人满意地履行职责。

3. 本会作为一个团体，拥有自己的会所，作为成员的娱乐和聚会场所；对于失业且无生计的成员，则作为收容所。

4. 除奥伦堡哥萨克人外，所有对本会做出实质性服务的俄罗斯移民和外国人均有资格成为会员。——女性不能成为本会会员。

5. 布尔什维克不能成为本会会员，任何同情“赤色分子”的人也不能成为会员。

6. 每位会员每月向本会基金缴纳不少于墨洋0.50元的会费，并由司库出具收据。外国人每月缴纳不少于墨洋50.00元。首期会员费自1926年1月1日起算。

7. 无生计且无工作者免缴会员费。

8. 在本会成立后希望入会且此前未入会者，需缴纳入场费墨洋5.00元。

9. 只有身为奥伦堡哥萨克人的会员才有资格进入本会管理层。

10. 本会管理层由以下人员组成：

(a) 主席，其职责是全面指导本会事务并监管本会资金；

(b) 司库兼秘书，负责资金的接收、保管和支出（后者仅凭主席命令执行），并维护账目和处理通信等事务；

(c) 两名本会理事，作为管理层的一部分，负责解决各类问题。

11. 管理层可由主席召集，或在紧急情况下，由一名管理层成员通知召集。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

12. The disbursement of monies, the admittance or elimination of Members, as well as any other important questions which may crop up, are solved by the Management and fixed by decisions.

13. For the purpose of checking over property (taking inventory) and audit of funds, a Committee of Controllers will be elected, consisting of three Members, viz: one President and two Members of Committee. Such examinations are to be effected semi-annually and annually. The results of these examinations are to be fixed on paper.

14. Any Member who has committed himself by an unbecoming act, is to be eliminated from the Union.

15. Upon leaving the Membership of the Union or on being expelled from it, the monies as were paid by such party to the funds of the Union will not be returned.

16. A Member of the Union cannot be simultaneously a member of any other Cossack Union in Shanghai.

17. All questions are decided by the majority of votes, and two thirds of all the Members are to be at least present. The President of the Union or the President of a General Meeting enjoy the right of two votes.

THE above Rules were approved by the Members of the ORENBOURG COSSACK UNION in Shanghai, at their General Meeting on the third day of January, 1926, in this City of Shanghai.

For Secretary
J. G. Taskharoff
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

12. 资金支出、会员的接纳或除名，以及可能出现的任何其他重要问题，均由管理层解决并通过决议确定。

13. 为了核查财产（盘点）和审计资金，将选举产生一个由三名成员组成的监察委员会，即：一名主席和两名委员会成员。此类检查每半年和每年进行一次。检查结果须记录在案。

14. 任何行为不端的会员将被除名。

15. 退出本会或被本会开除者，其已向本会基金缴纳的款项不予退还。

16. 本会会员不得同时成为上海任何其他哥萨克联合会的会员。

17. 所有问题均由多数票决定，且至少须有三分之二全体会员出席。联合会主席或大会主席享有两票投票权。

上述章程于1926年1月3日在上海举行的奥伦堡哥萨克联合会全体会议上获得通过。

代秘书
J. G. 塔斯卡罗夫（J. G. Taskharoff）

February 16 1926

REPORT ON Baron Von Zadoff

Made by Ten. Cons. Cook. Forwarded by [Signature]

Sir,

Enquiries show that Baron Von Zadoff, residing at
No. 1199 Paoshan Road, is a native of Western Poland and
professes the Protestant Faith. In addition to Russian and
Polish, he speaks English (fluently), German and French.
He also knows stenography and typing and was employed from
November 1923 to January 1925 with the Associated Oil Company,
Robert Dollar Building, in a clerical capacity. Subsequently
he was employed by the American Trading Company for a period of
seven months and was discharged from that firm owing to cutting

army gazette publication, as a Cossack of the Orenburg Cossack

先生，

经查，居住于宝山路1199号的扎多夫男爵系波兰西部人，信奉新教。除俄语和波兰语外，他能说英语（流利）、德语和法语。他还懂速记和打字，曾于1923年11月至1925年1月期间在罗伯特·道尔大楼（Robert Dollar Building）的联合石油公司（Associated Oil Company）担任职员。此后，他在美国贸易公司（American Trading Company）任职七个月，后因该公司裁员而被解雇。随后，他在特鲁斯康钢铁有限公司（Truscon Steel Co. REPORT ON New Orenburgh Cossack Organization.

Made by Tem. Cons. Cook Forwarded by [Signature] B. & S.

Sir,

A society called the New Orenburgh Cossack
Organization, which has existed for some time, removed to
new offices at No. 315 Rue Bourgeat, French Concession, on
Sunday, February 14. This association's membership consists
of 32 Orenburgh Cossacks. All of these, except two, are
employed. They state that they were formerly connected
with the Cossack groups headed by Borodine and Shendrikoff,
but broke away from these societies because they lost faith
in the leaders. They further state that the Cossack
followers of both Borodine and Shendrikoff pass their time
in debauchery and senseless political discussions. Practices
of this nature are forbidden in the new organization which
claims to have been formed to provide Cossacks with a place
where they can meet to discuss matters of common interest to the
members, and where men temporarily unemployed can be accommodated.
The membership is strictly confined to Cossacks of "White"
opinions and special precautions are taken to prevent "Reds"
from obtaining admission. The membership fee is fixed at
50 cents per month, but some members give more, the subscription
from "Prince" Dolgorukoff alone being $50.00 per month.

The founders of the New Orenburgh Cossack Organization
claim that they are not opposed in any way to other "White"
organizations in Shanghai. Nevertheless they are viewed with
suspicion by some of the latter.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
[Signature]
Tem. Cons.

D. C. I.

1926年2月16日

关于新奥伦堡哥萨克组织的报告。

由临时警佐库克撰写 经由 [签名] 转呈 B. & S.

先生，

一个名为“新奥伦堡哥萨克组织”的社团已存在一段时间，于2月14日星期日迁至法租界勃艮第路（Rue Bourgeat）315号的新办公地点。该协会会员由32名奥伦堡哥萨克人组成。除两人外，其余均有职业。他们声称以前与博罗季涅（Borodine）和申德里科夫领导的哥萨克团体有联系，但因对领导人失去信心而脱离了这些社团。他们进一步指出，博罗季涅和申德里科夫的哥萨克追随者将时间浪费在放荡生活和无意义的政治讨论上。新组织禁止此类行为，声称其成立目的是为哥萨克人提供一个场所，让他们可以聚会讨论成员共同感兴趣的事项，并为暂时失业的人员提供安置。会员资格严格限于持有“白”色观点的哥萨克人，并采取特别预防措施以防止“红”色分子获准加入。会费定为每月50分，但有些会员捐赠更多，仅“亲王”多尔戈鲁科夫每月的捐款就达50.00美元。

新奥伦堡哥萨克组织的创始人声称，他们在任何方面都不反对上海的其他“白”色组织。尽管如此，后者中的一些人仍对他们持怀疑态度。

先生，
您顺从的仆人，
[签名]
临时警佐

副刑事调查处处长
